class.name: IfcRecurrencePattern
class.brief_description: IfcRecurrencePattern defines repetitive time periods on the basis of regular recurrences such as each Monday in a week, or every third Tuesday in a month. The population of the remaining attributes such as DayComponent , Position , and Interval depend on the specified recurrence type. HISTORY: New entity in IFC2x4. class.description: Only in IFC4 and IFC4X3_ADD2 files.

members.member: Defines the recurrence type that gives meaning to the used attributes and decides about possible attribute combinations, i.e. what attributes are needed to fully describe the pattern type. A String, one of the enumeration's values, or null when unset. Only in IFC4 and IFC4X3_ADD2 files: in others it reads as null and can't be set.
The position of the specified day in a month. A PackedInt64Array, or null when unset. Only in IFC4 and IFC4X3_ADD2 files: in others it reads as null and can't be set.
The weekday name of the specified day in a week. A PackedInt64Array, or null when unset. Only in IFC4 and IFC4X3_ADD2 files: in others it reads as null and can't be set.
The position of the specified month in a year. A PackedInt64Array, or null when unset. Only in IFC4 and IFC4X3_ADD2 files: in others it reads as null and can't be set.

The position of the specified component, e.g. the 3rd (position=3) Tuesday (weekday component) in a month. A negative position value is used to define the last position of the component (-1), the next to last position (-2) etc. An int, or null when unset. Only in IFC4 and IFC4X3_ADD2 files: in others it reads as null and can't be set.

An interval can be given according to the pattern type. An interval value of 2 can for instance every two days, weeks, months, years. An empty interval value is regarded as 1. The used interval values should be in a reasonable range, e.g. not 0 or <0. An int, or null when unset. Only in IFC4 and IFC4X3_ADD2 files: in others it reads as null and can't be set.

Defines the number of occurrences of this pattern, e.g. a weekly event might be defined to occur 5 times before it stops. An int, or null when unset. Only in IFC4 and IFC4X3_ADD2 files: in others it reads as null and can't be set.

List of time periods that are defined by a start and end time of the recurring element (day). The order of the list should reflect the sequence of the time periods. An Array of GDIFCEntityBase entities, or null when unset. Only in IFC4 and IFC4X3_ADD2 files: in others it reads as null and can't be set.
